From 23831e855aef98f7e97791d00adaf984b1b5311b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Robert Kanter <rkanter@cloudera.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2015 14:23:04 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] OOZIE-2377 Hive2 Action should not propagate oozie.hive2.*
 properties to Beeline (rkanter)


diff --git a/sharelib/hive2/src/main/java/org/apache/oozie/action/hadoop/Hive2Main.java b/sharelib/hive2/src/main/java/org/apache/oozie/action/hadoop/Hive2Main.java
index 56f5451ca..e122608b3 100644
--- a/sharelib/hive2/src/main/java/org/apache/oozie/action/hadoop/Hive2Main.java
+++ b/sharelib/hive2/src/main/java/org/apache/oozie/action/hadoop/Hive2Main.java
@@ -216,8 +216,8 @@ public class Hive2Main extends LauncherMain {
             arguments.add("--hiveconf");
             arguments.add("mapreduce.job.tags=" + actionConf.get(LauncherMain.MAPREDUCE_JOB_TAGS));
         }
-        // Propagate "oozie.*" configs
-        for (Map.Entry<String, String> oozieConfig : actionConf.getValByRegex("^oozie\\.(?!launcher).+").entrySet()) {
+        // Propagate "oozie.*" configs (but not "oozie.launcher.*" nor "oozie.hive2.*")
+        for (Map.Entry<String, String> oozieConfig : actionConf.getValByRegex("^oozie\\.(?!launcher|hive2).+").entrySet()) {
             arguments.add("--hiveconf");
             arguments.add(oozieConfig.getKey() + "=" + oozieConfig.getValue());
         }
--

### Modifications in Each File

1. **Hive2Main.java**
   - The code was modified to change the regular expression used for propagating Oozie configurations. 
   - The original line that propagated all "oozie.*" configurations was updated to exclude both "oozie.launcher.*" and "oozie.hive2.*" properties. 
   - This change ensures that properties specific to Hive2 actions are not passed to Beeline, which is the command-line interface for Hive.

2. **release-log.txt**
   - A new entry was added to the release log to document the change made in the Hive2 action regarding the propagation of "oozie.hive2.*" properties. 
   - The entry notes the issue number (OOZIE-2377) and the author of the change (rkanter).

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in **Hive2Main.java** directly addresses the issue described in the release log entry in **release-log.txt**. The change in the code prevents the propagation of specific properties ("oozie.hive2.*") to Beeline, which is a key aspect of the fix for the identified bug (OOZIE-2377). The addition in the release log serves to document this fix, providing context and traceability for future reference.
